meta.title: Moroccan Wedding Decoration in Nantes | Roi des Rois Déco
meta.description: Moroccan wedding, engagement and henna night decoration in Nantes and Loire-Atlantique: gold-embroidered velvet salons, red-carpet aisles, gold arches and equipment hire. Request a quote on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Modern elegance, the soul of tradition
hero.lead: Gold-embroidered velvet salons, lanterns, rugs and gold arches for your weddings, engagements and henna nights.
alts: Reception hall in Nantes, the couple's stage and a red carpet
Burgundy velvet Moroccan salon embroidered in gold beneath a crystal chandelier
Outdoor ceremony aisle with red carpet, gold arches and lanterns

manifesto.title: A tradition received like a palace
manifesto.body: Roi des Rois dresses your celebrations the way the great Moroccan houses do: deep velvets, gold-thread embroidery, chased brass and the soft glow of lanterns. Every setting is composed for your venue and your colours, from the salon of honour to the last glass on the table, in Nantes and across Loire-Atlantique.
manifesto.signature: Elevate your events: modern elegance meets Maghreb tradition.

items.title: Full decoration
items.body: We design the whole room: Moroccan salons, dressed tables, floral centrepieces, a henna corner and the couple's stage. We deliver, set up and take down.

items.title: Aisle & ceremony
items.body: An entrance people remember: a medallion red carpet, gold arches and columns, flower urns and lanterns on either side, indoors or out.

items.title: Equipment hire
items.body: Salons, cushions, low tables, henna trays, lanterns, rugs, arches: build your selection from the catalogue and we prepare everything for your date.

details.title: Beauty lies in the details
details.body: A trim pulled taut, embroidery set true, a gold-rimmed glass lined up with its cutlery. Repeated table after table, these small gestures are what make a room feel like a palace.
details.alt: Close-up of a burgundy velvet salon embroidered in gold thread

items.title: Wedding
items.body: Stage, aisle, salons and tables: a setting planned from your guests' first step to the last dance.
items.alt: Lit wedding stage with a white sofa and gold lanterns

items.title: Engagement
items.body: An embroidered salon, lanterns and gold trays to welcome both families in style.
items.alt: Teal Moroccan salon and an emerald round table with lanterns

items.title: Henna night
items.body: Vivid colours, ornate hangings, the henna tray and cushion: tradition in all its warmth.
items.alt: Henna night setting with green and red arches and gold trays

items.title: Private reception
items.body: Birthdays, new arrivals, family gatherings: tables dressed with care, scaled to your venue.
items.alt: Round table dressed in pink and white with candles and white flowers
